title: MS08 Evidence-to-Claim Admission Gate with Institute/Synth Origin Audit
scope: Resolve whether A3-21 originated the C.I.T./Institute or synth program, distinguish in-world chronology from franchise/player-facing introduction, and define an executable admission gate that separates evidence authenticity from proposition truth.

institute_and_synth_origin_audit.question: Did the university/Institute or the appearance/creation of synths begin with A3-21?

franchise_exposition_boundary.finding: A3-21/The Replicated Man is not the in-world origin of the Institute or synths, but Fallout 3 is the first released game in which the Institute faction and synth characters appear, and MS08 already uses the term 'synths'. The pre-War C.I.T. university itself was introduced separately later at the franchise level.

gate.name: MS08_MACHINE_VERIFIABLE_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_AND_ADMISSION_GATE
gate.goal: Admit HARKNESS_IS_POST_TRANSFORMATION_A3_21 from proposition-bound evidence while rejecting HARKNESS_IS_DEAD when the only physical exhibit is a genuine Android Component.

admission_semantics.evidence_authenticity: The evidence object or shipped record must be admitted as genuine within the configured authority scope.
admission_semantics.source_binding: The evidence must retain its source/custody/provenance binding.
admission_semantics.claim_binding: The evidence must explicitly support an atomic proposition required by the target claim; authenticity alone never creates this relation.
admission_semantics.counterevidence: A rule-based inference is blocked when shipped evidence supplies a counterexample to the inference rule.
admission_semantics.claim_rule: A target claim is admitted only when all required atoms are established by admissible evidence and no blocking atom is established.

positive_case.meaning: Three different evidence functions converge on one persistent-host identity relation: transformation operator record, subject-side recovered memory, and system-level reset binding.

reason: The component can be genuine without proving the proposition that Harkness is dead.
Zimmer's conclusion is an inference/belief, not direct death observation.
Victoria Watts supplies a shipped counterexample: the component can be removed/provided while A3-21/Harkness remains alive.
